notes: Both definite noun + הָאֶחָד phrases are rendered by a single each, given to the numeral, with the accompanying articles unrepresented (rules 41, 47).
In לַשֶּׂה the each goes to the noun rather than to the assimilated article; giving it to the article was the competing reading, but that would leave the lexical noun with no English at all (rule 2).
